answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the beacon log shows the live set and the quartz audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 302 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 210 aliases alive thus means 210 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the yarrow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
